name: raw_input_contract_v1
layout: 8192 words per window, row-major [sample, channel], channel order of src/config.py
rule: FS_c = next power of two >= 1.25 x max|x| over the training split only
note: The FPGA's per-window z-score is scale invariant, so FS_c only sets the resolution of the simulated ADC; the hardware never uses it.
